description: Block commands with block entity data: setblock with a chest's items, clone copies the chest, data merge and modify change it, execute if/unless block and if data test its items; fill hollow, clone move and a redstone block powering a lamp.

actions.command: execute if block 3 1 1 minecraft:chest{Items:[{id:"minecraft:diamond"}]} run setblock 3 2 1 minecraft:gold_block
execute unless block 1 1 1 minecraft:chest{Items:[{id:"minecraft:diamond"}]} run setblock 1 2 1 minecraft:emerald_block
data modify block 3 1 1 Items[0].count set value 5
execute if data block 3 1 1 Items[{count:5}] run setblock 4 2 1 minecraft:diamond_block
